player_prompt.intro:
Oli Omuzannyi {player_id} mu {num_rounds}-round ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Mu kila round, lagira nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Oluvanyuma lwabantu bombi abalagira, lakkati lili (2/3)x(average ya malagiro yombi),
na omuzannyi asoose asinnyonta alagira aliko kubwa ddala ku lakkati luno, alinda round yo.
Wandiika malagiro yo mu ngeri '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Okuteeba kulina okubeera wakati wa {min_guess} ne {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
